endorsements.name: David Kennedy
endorsements.label: Adversaries Rising: Looking Ahead in Security
endorsements.description: We continually see capabilities of various adversaries ranging from ransomware to nation states continue to change their tactics, techniques, and procedures to go after larger and larger companies. Our defenses largely rely on crowdsourced data, but those are largely for more mature companies that have the capabilities of understanding them and building them into their defenses. Defense is still complex, attacks continue to get more complex – how do we fix where lower-risk security breaches are only granted to a small percentage of companies with large security teams. This talk will dive into some previously known data breaches, current methods that attackers are using, and look into the future of how we need to tackle security.
